notes.title: Flaw with Map Item discovered and is now resolved.
notes.content:
A flaw with the game map item was discovered and resolved. If a player lost a battle in certain areas, the game map item would not register the change in locations. This problem has now been resolved and the game map item should work correctly. 

For players that have already experienced this problem in their current save file, the solution is to return to the incorrect location that the map item is showing and then exit that area. If a player has lost a battle in more than one affected area, this may have to be done for each area that was vulnerable to this problem.

notes.title: Weather Problem Resolved
notes.content: It was discovered that if the player loses a battle with an NPC at Splash Path or The Snowy Path the weather effect would not stop until the player returned to and then exited that same area. This problem has been corrected.

notes.title: Pre Creature Collector Fest Update
notes.content:
The number of data pieces needed to create a file for Chewdent and Gooroach has been reduced to 3 instead of 5.

The value of baked cookies sold at the market has been reduced. Baked cookies were intended as a source of healing help for the player in the earlier part of the game. It was not meant to be used to grind for money.

The price of water, carrot seeds, potato seeds, and bell pepper seeds has all been reduced.

notes.title: Fisherman NPC update
notes.content:
The fisherman NPC will now tell the player to look for bubbles in the water and to have fish bait ready if they want to use the fishing feature in the game.

I realized that some players may not have noticed the bubbles in the water during gameplay

notes.title: Goldama's Signature Move "Royal Flush" has been corrected
notes.content:

It was higher than 20%. It is now at 20%.

notes.title: Inventory Menu and Task System Update
notes.content:
This new update replaces the original inventory system. It provides separate brackets for consumable items and monster data.

New key item task instructions have been added to the game to help players navigate the game world in the recommended order. Players who choose to ignore the recommended path can utilize a new key item that can manually remove location tasks if necessary.

Many buff and debuff moves now have a reduced MP cost.

notes.title: New Improvements For D.A.M. Champion Players
notes.content:
- A new type chart item can be obtained at the beginning of the game from a FAAFO Corp. staff member.

notes.title: A Message To The Fans
notes.content: For the players that enjoyed the game. It would be helpful if you add a review for the game. When a game gets more reviews, the algorithm starts showing the game to more people, which helps its online exposure.

notes.title: Slight Adjustment

notes.title: November 19 Patch Update
notes.content:
- A second pathway in the sandstorm arena has been corrected to avoid the player getting stuck.

- Almost all TVs and Clocks will say something different after defeating the final boss.

notes.title: Gameplay Improvement Patch
notes.content:
Attack moves now indicate if it is a physical attack [ATK] or special attack [SAT], the player will no longer have to rely on the description of the attack move.
 I increased the average walking distance for wild encounters to not feel overwhelming.
 I have reduced a lot of the MP costs for attack moves to better reflect the potential damage output. For example, most of the heavy attacks are now around 12 and 15 MP cost.

notes.title: The Mysterious Bug Has Been Fixed
notes.content: The mysterious bug error discovered at the Cricket Village Temple Training Area has been corrected. Everyone should make sure that their version of the game D.A.M. Champion is up to date. If you have already spoken with the monster that guards the bridge with questions and answered all of their questions correctly, you will need to start a new game.

notes.title: New Trailer, Game Feature, and Post Game Content
notes.content:
D.A.M. Champion Trailer #3
[previewyoutube=8tIH1VlK76s;full][/previewyoutube]

New Game Feature

I have added the option for players to choose a difficulty setting when they start the game. The difficulty setting will determine how challenging each major boss fight will be. The choices are named "Easy", "Medium" and "D.A.M.". The third choice would be the most difficult.

Post Game Content

I originally was not planning on having any post-game content after feeling overwhelmed with production, but for the people who have been waiting to play this game, I decided to create a battle tower that the player can visit after defeating the final boss of the game. A water pathway will be available in the southwest section of Brodie Beach. This pathway will lead to the battle tower.

More...

I hope that players will enjoy this game when it releases in November. I would like to continue making more D.A.M. Champion games in the future with significant improvements with each new generation. I always wondered what a monster taming game universe would look like if the game studio listened to the feedback of supportive players and focused on making a more enjoyable game with each new addition.

notes.title: Latest Update On D.A.M. Champion
notes.content:
Ikari Creative is proud to reveal that the game D.A.M. Champion will include 120 Monsters. The 8 remaining monsters will soon be revealed.

The game will include 31 Passive Abilities and over 170 Attack Skills.

Through the option to make heroic or villainous decisions, D.A.M. Champion will offer the player 2 possible game endings. This will be based on the player's collective choices throughout their journey. That is a great compliment to the multiple save slots that D.A.M. Champion offers.
